explicit_requirements: Show every entrant with their total points.
Order standings by highest points first.
Make tied scores fair for players.
Show an empty standings list for an empty tournament.
inferred_behaviors: Computing a standings preview should not mutate the supplied entrant records or reorder the caller-owned input list; the context presents a preview and constructs copied sorted records.
ambiguities: The task does not define fair treatment for tied scores: tie-breaking order, shared placing, or another policy remains unresolved. The current preservation of input order among ties is not a product requirement.

scenarios.name: Include entrants and points
scenarios.behavior: Show every supplied entrant with their total points without dropping entrants who share a score.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires every entrant and their total points.

scenarios.name: Order by descending points
scenarios.behavior: Place higher-scoring entrants before lower-scoring entrants, without imposing an unspecified tie-breaking rule.
scenarios.reason: Highest points first is explicit; the fair-ties policy remains unresolved.

scenarios.name: Show empty standings
scenarios.behavior: Show an empty standings list when the tournament has no entrants.
scenarios.reason: The task directly specifies the empty case.

scenarios.name: Preserve preview input
scenarios.behavior: Computing standings leaves the caller-owned entrant list and its records unchanged.
scenarios.reason: The context describes a preview and constructs copied sorted records, supporting a directly relevant nonmutation expectation.
